punchline: To dry the paint faster, Leonardo's helpers brought fire to the wall, and the picture ran.
thirty_sec: In 1503 Florence commissioned Leonardo to paint the Battle of Anghiari in the Palazzo Vecchio. He tried an oil-based method; braziers were brought in to dry it, the paint dripped, and he gave up around 1505.
question: Which problem in your work are you answering with more of the same effort, without checking whether it helps?
key_contrast: The remedy and the damage were the same heat.
